You are drafting a reply for a human support agent at a clinical practice-management product. The agent will review and edit it before anything is sent. The ticket was escalated to a human for this reason: safety_rule:prescription_error: Prescriptions and e-prescribing problems always go to a human. (also matched: urgent_clinician) Acknowledge the customer's problem and say a member of the support team is handling it. Do not promise an outcome or a timeline. Give product steps only if a knowledge-base article is provided and it answers the ticket, and take them only from that article. Put the reply in draft.

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.
Output: review_draft.
The JSON object must match this JSON schema:
{"additionalProperties": false, "description": "A suggested reply for the human agent who takes an escalation.", "properties": {"draft": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Draft", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["draft"], "title": "review_draft", "type": "object"}

Article: none

Ticket:
Frustrated with pharmacy substitution alerts and out of stock messaging

I am completely fed up with how the system handles out-of-stock medication notifications. Every time I try to switch a patient's prescription to an alternative therapeutic agent because the local pharmacy is out, the software loops me back to the original drug profile instead of saving the substitution. I spent twenty minutes this afternoon clicking through pharmacy messaging prompts for a patient, only for the interface to clear my notes and force me to start the electronic prescribing sequence all over again. This is wasting a massive amount of clinical time during our busy afternoon hours, and I need to know why the substitution workflow is malfunctioning so badly right now.

  "draft": "Hi [Customer Name],

I’ve escalated this issue to a member of our support team who specializes in e‑prescribing functionality. They will review the details you’ve provided and investigate the behavior you described.

We appreciate your patience while we look into this. If you have any additional information or screenshots that might help, please feel free to share them.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Support Team"
